title: Catalog of Second Chances (CSC) - Digital Database and Corresponding Interfaces for ReUse of Architectural Components (v0.6.4.2)
description:
The Catalog of Second Chances (CSC) is a prototypical digital component database. It catalogs digital representations of uniquely identifiable architectural components for reuse. Furthermore, it provides corresponding interfaces and tools to leverage them via a backend REST-API, a web-frontend as well as a interface for direct interaction within Rhino Grasshopper.

Changes in v0.6.4.2 (2026-10-29)

Second hardening: the web app and the backend. The Grasshopper fixes follow in 0.6.4.3.

Added

  • Data Model page: /reference explains the data model for catalog users: the dataset, the component identity, its versions and the evidence records, how they relate, the rules of the model, the fields a user sees or fills in, every vocabulary with a short meaning per value, and one made-up concrete beam followed through all of them as an example, in seven tabs. It is public and linked in the sidebar next to Grasshopper. GET /vocab gives each vocabulary value a one-line description.
  • Browse, evidence method: a filter for elements with a published record of one evidence method, for example the elements with a reinforcement layout.
  • Profile, website of the organisation: the profile holds the website of the user's organisation (http or https). New evidence records copy it into the "You" performer, and "Add my organisation" in the performers field adds the organisation as a performer of its own.

Changed

  • History: a reinforcement layout in the History graph opens in the viewer, as "Show in viewer" does. A corrected record opens the corrected records before the page scrolls to it, and on another element the page scrolls once its records have loaded.
  • Viewer: with a reinforcement layout opened by its link, the diameter colours and their legend follow the bars of that layout.
  • Credits and imprint use the layout and text sizes of the privacy page.
  • Component page: the evidence card has its own "Add evidence" button, like the properties card, and the properties card explains with a "?" that its values come from the evidence. In the History graph, a group of one record opens that record with the first click.
  • Wording: a single building component is called an "element" in the web app, the mails, the API descriptions and the MCP connector, instead of "piece". The Grasshopper descriptions follow in 0.6.4.3.
  • Statistics: /identities/stats no longer returns the size facet bbxX, which no page showed.
  • An unknown evidence method or token scope gives a 422 on every server, also with an older Starlette.

Security

  • Session expiry on a component page: when the session ends, a page that shows more than an anonymous visitor may see (a private element, a draft or pending version, a record only the user may load) signs the user out and leads to the sign-in page, which returns to the same address. A public element stays readable and is shown again as an anonymous visitor sees it.
  • Sign-in: the return address after sign-in only accepts addresses on this site.
  • Dependencies: the development tool shadcn moves to 4.22.1, pinned exactly; no package in the lockfile was published after 2026-10-19. Two dev-only advisories of npm audit stay open, both through shadcn: body-parser (high; its fix came out on 2026-10-22) and deepmerge (low; no fix yet). The production install has none.

Server notes

  • No step needed: no new setting, collection or index. The profile field is optional.

Full history: CHANGELOG.md
